item.title: Kinosaki Winter Crab: Matsuba Snow Crab Feasts — Guide
item.description: Between November and March, the hot spring town of Kinosaki turns into one of Japan’s great eating destinations. The Sea of Japan just to the north yields matsuba-gani, the male snow crab landed at nearby ports and tagged by port of origin, and the town’s ryokan build entire multi-course dinners around a single crab: sashimi of translucent raw legs, legs grilled over charcoal until the shell blisters, whole boiled crab, a simmering hotpot, and finally rice porridge cooked in the broth.
